acceptance_predicates.description: PhaseContext and every generated operation are derived from one admitted LiveUpgradeBinding and reject identity drift.
The production seam dispatches the generated eight phases through UpgradeEngine in dependency order and records durable outcomes.
Missing capabilities, injected failures, process death, stale state, and ambiguous effects fail or enter safe mode without false success.
Git and SQLite use the same evidence and identity contract with concrete backend fixtures.

definition_of_done: A production phase-capability factory binds generated operations to an admitted Git or SQLite live binding.
UpgradeEngine remains the sole ordered journal/evidence boundary.
Git and SQLite injected-failure and process-death evidence passes independently.
Public mutation remains fail-closed if any required phase capability is absent.
Exact-head independent review, hosted checks, post-merge verification, and state reconciliation pass.
No source-to-model refinement proof or authorized prerequisite is required.

inputs.description: AR-0104 and AR-0105 admitted canonical Git/SQLite LiveUpgradeBinding.
Existing UpgradeEngine journal, phase evidence, fencing, and recovery contract.
Validated generated eight-phase upgrade contract and rollback operation.

outputs.description: Production factory and integration tests for identity-bound phase orchestration.

gates.description: All phase contexts and operations retain the admitted project, revision, fence, barrier, and backend identity.
Injected failure and process-death outcomes are durable and truthful.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head and hosted result.
